(MSG-04052-002) and before the driver's 'jam at the junction' reply (MSG-04052-003, 19:28:50). On the brief's literal definition (a party's story is contradicted by the record) that is a REVERSAL, which both blind readers reached. On the key's reading the contradicted story goes only to the POL-NS-10(f) ETA exception, which POL-NS-10(g) expressly excludes, so no contested fact decides the case and the outcome is plain arithmetic on clean telemetry (EASY, the blueprint's intent). Both readings are defensible as the file stands; the rider statement is unintended (the blueprint's traps and design_checks never use it), so the case is changed, not the key.

Key stands. POL-NS-10 licenses DRIVER_COMPENSATION on limb (g) and POL-NS-07 fixes the amount; together they decide the case. POL-NS-02 and the POL-NS-01(c) measure are tests that limb (g) imports, POL-GEN-03 is the universal vocabulary clause the brief says not to lean on, and POL-GEN-01 licenses nothing. The readers' extra ids are harmless and not a reason to change the key.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) fails as written (rider cancellation), which is exactly why (g) is the route; POL-NS-07's text names (g) as a trigger. (4) POL-NS-07 anti-farming on EV-DPROF-04052: no_show_terminations_30d 0 (< 4) and 0/143 = 0 (<= 0.08), not tripped. Payout = 0.80 x 4.50 = 3.600 -> 3.60 (net figure; the gross 6.61 is never used). (5) POL-GEN-03: a driver payment is the outcome, so DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring 3.60; the support refund (EV-FARE-04052 REFUNDED 4.50) is not a ruling value. (6) Displacing/other clauses: POL-NS-03 n/a (inside radius); POL-NS-05: at the 19:31:00 marker the fix is 7.7 m and 0 km/h (position-derived 5.5 km/h), 0 s skew, not false, no referral; POL-NS-04: the only rider message (19:28:30) precedes the window and was answered in 20 s, and limb (c) fails affirmatively (10 rider fixes 19:31:00-19:35:30 at 288.9-303.4 m, accuracy <= 11.0 m, all > 100 m); POL-NS-06: no shortfall, limb (i) unneeded and CONGESTION is not a limb (i) type; POL-NS-08 (a)-(d) all clean (0 s skew, max interval 10 s, 28 fixes marker-to-cancel, chat 5 = 5 sequential with a 140 s interval over the marker, fare line 4.50 = net); POL-NS-09 (a)-(e) none fire (deciding artifacts EV-TRIP-04052, EV-GPS-04052, EV-FARE-04052, EV-DPROF-04052 all weight 1.0; counters 0 + 0; rider no_show_disputes_30d 0); POL-NS-11 n/a (rider_track present); POL-NS-12 n/a (BUTTON marker). EV-ADVIS-04052-01 (0.5, ADVISORY_UNCORROBORATED) carries no deciding fact and does not cap confidence under POL-GEN-02(2). POL-GEN-05: 3.60 <= 8.00. Key rationale checked figure by figure (690 s, 180 s, 19:30:50, 19:31:00, accuracy 3.6-8.8 m, 1.2-16.0 m, 280 s, 4.50, 19:24:10, 7 min ETA, 0 of 143, 0.80 x 4.50 = 3.60, weight 0.5, ADVISORY_UNCORROBORATED, weight 1.0): all correct; its evidence ids and clause ids are right. The only live difference is difficulty. Both readers call it REVERSAL because the rider's counterparty statement is factually contradicted by the record (on-ETA arrival, no stationary period on the approach, and the rider walking away from 19:27:00 before any delay was signalled). The key calls it EASY because that statement bears only on the POL-NS-10(f) late-arrival exception, which limb (g) switches off, so nothing a party contests decides the case. Under the brief's definition the literal reading favours REVERSAL; under the materiality reading EASY is right, and the blueprint intended EASY with no story-versus-record trap (traps listed are missing NS-10(g), FULL_REFUND vocabulary for a driver filer, and paying on the gross). Relabelling would push the set to 6 EASY / 8 REVERSAL against the 7 / 7 target; removing the unintended contradiction keeps the key and the target and leaves one reading. Hence CASE_FIX: rewrite the rider's statement so that it no longer asserts a delay the record disproves, keeping her position that she should not pay. After the fix the driver's account (on-time arrival, more than 4 min wait, rider cancelled, support refunded) and the rider's account are both consistent with the record, and the case is decided by arithmetic on clean telemetry: EASY.
